Command parsing, stage checks, init and fini execution, and path ownership and mode checks.

# Purpose
This file implements the `configure` action for Firedancer. It parses command line arguments, selects one or more configuration stages, checks the permissions needed for each stage, and then runs the stage logic for `init`, `check`, or `fini`. The main entry points are [`configure_cmd_args`](<#configure_cmd_args>), [`configure_cmd_perm`](<#configure_cmd_perm>), and [`configure_cmd_fn`](<#configure_cmd_fn>), which together define how the command is accepted, how access rights are requested, and how each stage is executed. The code also handles special cases such as the `all` keyword, reverse-order cleanup for `fini`, and error handling when a stage is not configured, only partly configured, or already valid.

The file also provides helper functions for file system state checks. [`check_path`](<#check_path>), [`check_dir`](<#check_dir>), and [`check_file`](<#check_file>) compare the current owner, group, mode, and type of a path against expected values and return a configuration result. At the end of the file, `fd_action_configure` registers the `configure` action with its name, argument parser, execution function, permission function, description, and permission error text. This makes the file a command implementation and external action definition for the configuration system.
